name: PLS Clock HUD
overview: PLS Clock HUD turns your phone into an always-on heads-up display: a big clock and date, weather, a status bar that mirrors your phone, and an email ticker, all in a hologram look you control. Everything on the screen can be moved, resized, restyled and re-formatted by touch, and it runs offline except for the weather and the update check.

capabilities.title: Big clock and date
capabilities.text: An always-on clock and date in the font, size and color you pick, with a FORMAT list for 12/24 hour, seconds, and short or long dates.

proofs.caption: Day only: THU (hologram glitch mid-burst)
Short: THU, NOV 19
Long: Thursday, November 19, 2026

capabilities.title: Hologram effects
capabilities.text: Glitch bursts, scan lines, flicker, drift, a slow spin and more, each on its own switch with its own strength and timing.

proofs.caption: Hologram glitch caught mid-burst
10 seconds of the hologram running

capabilities.title: Weather cards
capabilities.text: Live weather for where you are plus saved places: temperature, high and low, and a sky icon, in small or BIG looks.

proofs.caption: Live location card (bench has no GPS fix, so it shows Finding you)
Weather card, second look

capabilities.title: Buttons always in reach
capabilities.text: Info, Invert, Themes, Color, Dim and Edit sit in a row of red pills at the top; hide them and the first tap brings them back.

proofs.caption: The pill row: INFO · INVERT · THEMES · COLOR · DIM · EDIT

capabilities.title: Dim for night driving
capabilities.text: One tap steps the whole screen down (100%, 75%, 50%, 25%) so it never blinds you at night.

proofs.caption: Dimmed to 25%

capabilities.title: Move and resize anything
capabilities.text: Edit mode puts the yellow MOVE handle on every item: drag it, tap for RESIZE, magnets line things up, green check keeps it, red undo takes it back.

proofs.caption: Edit mode with the undo, check and handle buttons

capabilities.title: Status bar that mirrors your phone
capabilities.text: Battery, signal, 5G/LTE, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, volume and alarm, drawn in your HUD colors.

proofs.caption: The status row drawn in HUD colors: signal, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, volume, alarm, calendar, mail and message counts, battery 100%. Two demo texts give the message count of 2.

capabilities.title: Email and message ticker
capabilities.text: Counts and the newest subjects from your email, messages and Discord, from the phone's own notifications.

capabilities.title: Themes
capabilities.text: Nine one-tap looks, from Pulse Red and All White to Blood Brass with chopped frames and label tabs.

proofs.caption: The Themes sheet: all nine looks, each one tap.
Blood Brass.
Corvette HUD.

capabilities.title: Windshield mode
capabilities.text: Flips the whole screen in a mirror so it reads right when reflected in the windshield at night.

proofs.caption: Windshield mode on: the whole HUD flipped so it reads right as a reflection.

capabilities.title: Glass reflection
capabilities.text: A faint second image under the first, like real windshield glass, with its own distance and strength.

proofs.caption: The same clock without and with the glass reflection effect: a faint second image under the first.

capabilities.title: Now playing, video and music
capabilities.text: Shows what's playing and can place a video or song player right in the layout.

proofs.caption: A video player placed in the layout, playing a demo test-pattern clip.

capabilities.title: Launch pad
capabilities.text: A grid of up to 50 tiles that open apps, websites, files or quick actions.

proofs.caption: Launch pad tiles in the layout (quick actions plus two empty + tiles).
Tapping the Alarms tile opens the phone's Clock app on its alarm list.

capabilities.title: Reminders
capabilities.text: Set reminders that ring full screen, even with the HUD running.

proofs.caption: A demo reminder set for 10:08 PM: “Fuel stop at exit 42”.
The reminder ringing over the running HUD, with Snooze 10 min and done.

capabilities.title: Backgrounds
capabilities.text: A color, a picture, or a slideshow behind the HUD.

proofs.caption: A picture behind the HUD (a demo gradient).

capabilities.title: Saved setups
capabilities.text: Save whole layouts and switch between them, separately for portrait and landscape.

proofs.caption: Two saved setups, Day and Night, in Settings.
Loading the Night setup.

capabilities.title: Screensaver and live wallpaper
capabilities.text: The same HUD as the phone's screensaver while charging, or as a live wallpaper.

proofs.caption: The HUD offered as a live wallpaper (preview).
PLS Clock HUD listed among the phone's screen savers.

capabilities.title: Built for the Fold
capabilities.text: Separate layouts for folded, open and landscape, centered automatically when the screen changes.

proofs.caption: Folded: the cover-screen layout.
Open: the inner-screen layout.
Landscape on the inner screen.
